pages.title: ORSA Thermal Survey Optic
pages.text: $(bold)Recovered designation:$() Surveyor Lens.$(br2)The Returned Architect carried optics tuned to infrastructure instead of faces. ORSA engineers have repurposed one into a field scanner for detecting $(bold)active thermal anchors$() underground.$(br2)$(italic)Translation: the monster's eye now helps you find the one heater you forgot to refuel.$()

pages.title: Field Use
pages.text: $(bold)Acquisition:$() Returned Architects occasionally drop a $(item)Surveyor Lens$().$(br2)$(bold)Passive mode:$() Hold it in hand or offhand to bring up a thermal wash over your visor. Nearby heat infrastructure is marked automatically.$(br2)$(bold)Ping:$() Right-click to pulse for nearby $(l:advanced/geothermal_core)Geothermal Cores$(/l), lit Thermal Heaters, surfaced $(l:heating/geothermal_vents)geothermal vents$(/l), $(l:advanced/acheron_forge)Acheron Forges$(/l), and ORSA Transponders.$(br2)$(italic)Base model still ignores lava, candles, and Kevin from Logistics.$()

pages.title: Calibrated Array
pages.text: $(bold)Upgrade:$() Lens + $(l:orsa_rd/soul_harvesting)Architect Soul$(/l) + 4 $(item)Refined Acheronite$() + diamond. ORSA insists this is calibration, not occult possession.$(br2)$(bold)Result:$() Longer range, more markers, and enough filtering to separate real infrastructure from torch-and-lava clutter.

pages.title: ORSA Thermal Visor
pages.text: $(bold)Wearable optics:$() Two calibrated lenses, one scrap of insulated cloth, and an iron housing turned into a proper visor.$(br2)Worn on the head, it keeps the thermal overlay running hands-free and adds meaningful cold protection.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA called the rebreather 'field sufficient.' Legal made them remove 'probably.'$()

pages.title: Visor Assembly
pages.text: $(bold)Result:$() Passive thermal vision while worn, +20C cold resistance, and a brief emergency air buffer in vacuum.$(br2)Pair it with an EVA body rig and oxygen to stretch tank life noticeably longer.
